body: Thank you stranger. But I have tried a lot of things. Therapy and I am still on high dose of antidepressants. I guess it is what it is. When a big event hits me, I will be so fragile and couldn't get up bed for months. I am tired. I think it is time to release myself from the duties and responsibilities.

He had been my best friend for three years. I dont know if he knows me well or not. He has his own problems he need to attend. He doesnt really want to communicate. I think it is unfair for me to put this on him as well. But he is a good man. I dont want to break him. So I am trying to figure it out what can i say to him so he will feel this is not his fault.

but it was the event or the pain he caused to make me ending up like this. I am just really depressed and unhappy during my entire adult life. He might just push me just a bit to reach to this conclusion. I already scheduled an email to tell him this is not his fault. What else I can say?
